pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   B. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.

4. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.

5. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   C. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   D. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   C. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

8. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   D. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

10. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   D. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   B. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.

13. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

14. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   C. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   C. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
